        (
            COALESCE(LEFT(m.manip_signals->>'spoof_prob', LENGTH(m.manip_signals->>'spoof_prob')-1)::real / 100.0, 0) +
            COALESCE((m.manip_signals->>'front_run')::real / 100.0, 0) +

            COALESCE(o.off_mkt, 0) +
            COALESCE(o.x_freq, 0) +
            COALESCE(m.stuff_idx, 0) +
            CASE WHEN m."layer_idx" = 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
        ) / 5.0 as sai,
        -- PAS: |pat_rec/100 - peer_corr|
        ABS(COALESCE(r.pat_rec / 100.0, 0) - COALESCE((mc.market_metrics->>'peer_corr')::real, 0)) as pas
    FROM trade_records t 
    JOIN manipulation_signals m ON t."REC_KEY" = m."REC_TAG"
    JOIN reg_compliance r ON t."REC_KEY" = r."REC_COMP"
    JOIN market_conditions mc ON m."REC_TAG" = mc."REC_PIN"
    JOIN order_behaviour o ON t."REC_KEY" = o."REC_NODE"
)
SELECT "REC_KEY", ROUND(CAST((sai + pas) / 2.0 AS numeric), 4) as composite_suspicion_score
FROM trade_scores ORDER BY composite_suspicion_score DESC LIMIT 10;

        ABS(COALESCE(r.pat_rec / 100.0, 0) - COALESCE(((mc.market_metrics->>'peer_corr')::real + 1.0) / 2.0, 0.5)) as pas
